followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the intentional 11 July 2025 Pharr access blockade by agricultural producers, distinct from the April 2022 trucker inspection protest and from earlier-week recurrences. Retain trucks and reported private vehicles attempting entry toward the United States from the Mexican gate. The reported commercial return is not silently treated as a separately observed passenger restoration. Retain same-day evidence and withhold elapsed duration. El Diario’s 10:00 onset, NotiGAPE’s earlier report time and Hora Cero’s 14:30 commercial return are not forced into an exact hours calculation. A proposed partial release is not an actual endpoint. Retain Policy and socioeconomic demands / Jobs, services and livelihoods, based on attributed sorghum compensation and agricultural-support demands. The protest’s use of a trade bridge does not alone supply a protectionist motive. Contemporary local and national reports support occurrence and same-day return, but clock details and cohort precision differ. NotiGAPE remains an inspected indexed passage after its earlier direct-access failure; no presumed independence of every repeated event claim. Retain unlocated Mexican access to Pharr–Reynosa and null coordinates. The separate domestic highway actions and other international bridges are not added to this phase.
